hook: Four people rode this capsule down from orbit.
narration: Four people were inside this capsule as it fell out of orbit.
Crew-6 had spent one hundred eighty-six days in space.
On September third, their Dragon undocked and headed home.
Four minutes out, at three hundred fifty miles an hour, two small drogue chutes opened.
Then the four main parachutes opened, about six thousand feet up.
Drogues steady a falling capsule so the big mains can open safely.
[short pause] It splashed down off Jacksonville, Florida.
The recovery ship lifted the capsule aboard with the crew still inside.
outcome: Then the crew was taken out of the spacecraft, back on Earth at last.
title: Falling from orbit with 4 people inside
description:
NASA's SpaceX Crew-6 returned from the International Space Station in the Dragon Endeavour, which splashed down off Jacksonville, Florida, on Sept. 4, 2023, after 186 days in space.
